title: Paneer Curry with German Twist
description: A creamy paneer curry with a unique German twist, served with crispy onions and a side of warm rye bread.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of ghee in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the paneer and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the zesty and cook for 1 minute.
Serve with crispy onions and a side of warm rye bread.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
